physicalNotes: Radius 0.44963868 Jupiter radii from Mann et al. 2016 (2016AJ....152...61M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract): 32,145.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
